name: pm-personal-income-tax-2025
description: Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon personal income tax for 2025 income declared in the 2026 campaign, under article 95 of the local tax code. Covers who is liable, household shares, the twelve-band schedule per share from 0% to 55%, worked one-share and two-share calculations, the 2026 deadlines (31 March paper, 30 April online for residents, 15 May for non-residents), foreign income disclosure, the departure inconsistency, and the youth reduction of article 103 octies (5,000 euros per household over five years, aged 25 or under) in force from 1 January 2026. Does not use mainland French bands. Trigger phrases include impot sur le revenu Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, bareme IR SPM 2026, declaration revenus 2025 SPM, reduction jeunes 103 octies.
